title: The Index: Issue #208
content:
A round-up of round-ups of Black Friday deals

It's that time of year again! Let's have a look at the deals we, and our much loved community are offering this year. It's the most important time of year for independents, so let's give them our support 💛

Button sounds

Josh Comeau is here producing the goods, yet again. The CRT effect he's achieved is delightful too.

If your strategy is the same as everyone else’s, it’s not a strategy

Pavel here with plenty of sage advice on how to navigate an industry in flux.

The beauty of CSS mixins

Aside from $ variables I think mixins are the main thing I miss from Sass. This is going to be a very useful addition to CSS!

The Intl API: the best browser API you're not using

Kilian is one of the best in the biz at explaining APIs and this API really does reduce the need for third party dependencies.

As the credits roll on the AI industry, now is the time re-evaluate its use in your organisation

Things are not going well for the AI industry! I think it's time to reverse the mandates now, rather than waiting for the inevitable burst.

Sponsor message

Get all of our courses for half price!

We're not just a newsletter, but also a design and tech education publisher and until December 4, you can save a massive 50% off all of our courses. It's the lowest price any of the courses have been since pre-orders.

Every course purchase is distributed equally between author and publisher. Anything we keep gets invested right back into Piccalilli to provide as much free education as possible.
